# Refusals

Metal behavior that has no exact WebGPU or WGSL form on some or all hosts. A guest call or
shader that needs one of these is refused loudly: the Metal error where Metal defines one,
otherwise an unimplemented report naming the row, never a substitute. The device keeps
reporting the A10X's capabilities; a row is removed only when an exact emulation lands with
its tests. Each blocking clause is quoted and checked against the pinned text by
`tables/check.py`.

| Id | Area | Metal | Scope | Blocking clause | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| msaa-2x | render targets | Textures and pipelines with sample count 2 | all hosts | WebGPU multisample count must be 1 or 4. | [WebGPU #multisample-state](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#multisample-state) |
| custom-sample-positions | rasterization | Programmable sample positions (setSamplePositions:count:) | all hosts | WebGPU mandates the standard sample pattern. | [WebGPU #rasterization](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#rasterization) |
| alpha-to-one | blending | alphaToOneEnabled in a render pipeline | all hosts | GPUMultisampleState has count, mask and alphaToCoverageEnabled only. | [WebGPU #multisample-state](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#multisample-state) |
| counting-occlusion | queries | MTLVisibilityResultModeCounting | all hosts | A WebGPU occlusion result is only defined as zero or non-zero. | [WebGPU #occlusion](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#occlusion) |
| fill-mode-lines | rasterization | setTriangleFillMode:MTLTriangleFillModeLines | all hosts | GPUPrimitiveState has no fill mode. | [WebGPU #primitive-state](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#primitive-state) |
| depth-clamp | rasterization | setDepthClipMode:MTLDepthClipModeClamp | hosts without depth-clip-control | unclippedDepth requires the depth-clip-control feature. | [WebGPU #primitive-state](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#primitive-state) |
| vertex-stage-writes | shaders | Vertex functions that write device buffers or textures | all hosts | Bindings visible to the vertex stage must be uniform or read-only. | [WebGPU #bind-group-layout-creation](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#bind-group-layout-creation) |
| clip-distances | shaders | [[clip_distance]] outputs | hosts without clip-distances | The WGSL clip_distances built-in needs the clip_distances enable-extension, gated by the clip-distances feature. | [WebGPU Shading Language #enable-extensions-sec](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-WGSL-20261106/#enable-extensions-sec) |
| dual-source-blending | blending | Fragment outputs with [[color(0), index(1)]] | hosts without dual-source-blending | The WGSL blend_src attribute needs the dual_source_blending extension, gated by the dual-source-blending feature. | [WebGPU Shading Language #enable-extensions-sec](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-WGSL-20261106/#enable-extensions-sec) |
| stencil-export | shaders | [[stencil]] fragment output | all hosts | WGSL has no built-in output for a stencil reference. | [WebGPU Shading Language #built-in-values](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-WGSL-20261106/#built-in-values) |
| unorm16-filtering | formats | Linear filtering of R16/RG16/RGBA16 Unorm and Snorm textures | all hosts, unless the manual-filter path of plan 5.7 is used | These formats need texture-formats-tier1 and are only unfilterable-float. | [WebGPU #plain-color-formats](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#plain-color-formats) |
| float-view-reinterpretation | formats | Bit reinterpretation of float, snorm or packed texture data through views or buffer-backed textures | views: hosts on which texel copies of the format are not proven to keep every bit pattern (host/src/mem/proof.rs); buffer-backed textures: all hosts, until their copies take the proof | WebGPU texel copies preserve only finite, non-subnormal values and may change snorm and packed representations. | [WebGPU #texel-copies](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#texel-copies) |
| address-modes-with-mips-or-anisotropy | samplers | clampToZero, clampToBorderColor or mirrorClampToEdge combined with mipmap filtering or anisotropy; min-LOD clamp combined with anisotropy | all hosts | WebGPU has only clamp-to-edge, repeat and mirror-repeat, and WGSL sampling functions take no min-LOD clamp; the exact shader emulation covers nearest and bilinear filtering only (plan 5.7). | [WebGPU #GPUSamplerDescriptor](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#GPUSamplerDescriptor) |
| pull-model-interpolation | shaders | interpolant<T, P> with interpolate_at_center/centroid/sample/offset | all hosts | WGSL interpolates inputs only through their declared @interpolate attribute (AirWgsl family pull-model-interpolation). | [WebGPU Shading Language #builtin-functions](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-WGSL-20261106/#builtin-functions) |
| float-and-64-bit-atomics | shaders | atomic_float and 64-bit atomics | all hosts (not on the A10X's family; refused if a module reaches them) | WGSL atomics are 32-bit integer only (and the vec2u min/max extension). | [WebGPU Shading Language #atomic-builtin-functions](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-WGSL-20261106/#atomic-builtin-functions) |
| ray-tracing | shaders | Ray tracing and intersection functions | all hosts (not on the A10X's family) | WebGPU has no ray tracing. | [WebGPU #gpufeaturename](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webgpu-20260915/#gpufeaturename) |
| eac-r11-software-path | formats | Sampling EAC R11/RG11 textures on hosts without texture-compression-etc2 | hosts without texture-compression-etc2, until the device's decoded value is measured | Khronos allows either the 11-bit value or its bit-replicated extension; the A10X's choice is unknown (formats.toml question 6.3-eac-r11-decode). | [Khronos Data Format Specification #Section-r11eac](https://registry.khronos.org/DataFormat/specs/1.4/dataformat.1.4.html#Section-r11eac) |
